items.title: The Mail Counter That Took Its Rent Elsewhere
items.pitch: Invest in a clothing shop’s genuine postal-counter proposal. A later staffed service may move to its own premises, ending the actual rent the mail counter paid the shop owner.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A clothing-store file contains an unfunded postal fit-out quote and an unsigned agency offer.

clues.line: The actual provider in {year} had a valid opportunity, but the shop had not completed its counter.

window.notes: Bind clothing_shop to A actual adult-owned business. B is a real qualified prospective postal-counter worker. Baseline has no completed in-store counter. Require an existing authorized mail provider, suitable space, a genuine positive rental offer and actual permitted operating terms; no mail, provider or customers are invented.

interventions.how_it_looks: Invest ordinary shop capital toward the actual authorized counter fit-out.

ripples.headline: A Shop Opens Its Actual Authorized Postal Counter
ripples.body: The funded inspected counter opens under its real agency and positive-rent agreement.

ripples.headline: A Shop Fills Its Qualified Postal-Counter Vacancy
ripples.body: The qualified worker freely accepts the actual funded lawful position with the required provider authorization.

ripples.headline: A Postal Counter Completes Its Approved Relocation
ripples.body: The real new facility and qualified coverage are operating before the old counter closes. Its actual rent agreement ends on settled terms.

fails.headline: The Investment Does Not Open the Counter
fails.body: The capital follows ordinary shop finances, but no qualifying counter or rental entitlement is created.

present_day.best: If the chain and relocation persist in {now}, the clothing shop no longer contains the authorized counter and the actual provider notice identifies its current separate premises.
present_day.worst: Without valid stages, retain actual stock, provider authority, contracts and staff rights. No independent postal facility appears automatically.
present_day.twist: {A} gains the real earlier counter rental income, then loses that continuing entitlement and the in-store postal visits when the contract lawfully ends.

npc_lines_after.line: The mail moved. The rent it paid me moved with it.

items.why_fun: A useful new service can change why people enter a shop and later take that reason somewhere else.

items.title: The Uniforms Left after the Last Rehearsal
items.pitch: Introduce a band director to a qualified dress-shop owner. School uniforms may sustain a real repair contract before a later independent band closure leaves the clothes available for another use.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A school file contains an unfilled uniform commission and an unused approved budget.

clues.line: The school in {year} had a genuine roster and budget, but had not found its qualified willing supplier.

window.notes: A and B are strangers relative to each other. A is the actual authorized band director and B a qualified adult shop owner. Bind a genuinely operating school band, real approved budget and eligible willing students. Baseline has no completed commission; no children, musicians or performances are created by meeting.

interventions.how_it_looks: Introduce the consenting director and supplier over the actual funded school brief.

ripples.headline: A School Completes Its Real Uniform Commission
ripples.body: The authorized funded order is completed and inspected for the actual eligible band roster. The school owns the delivered inventory.

ripples.headline: A Continuing Band Renews Its Actual Uniform Repair Contract
ripples.body: The lawful funded renewal covers only the existing real inventory and supported work.

ripples.headline: Retired Band Uniforms Enter an Authorized Costume Collection
ripples.body: After the independently recorded band closure, actual contract obligations are settled and the owner lawfully transfers the eligible retired clothes.

fails.headline: A Meeting Does Not Complete the Uniform Order
fails.body: The introduction happens, but no qualifying order is delivered. No school inventory or repair income appears automatically.

present_day.best: If the chain and transfer persist in {now}, the actual costume collection holds the identified retired uniforms and the school no longer books their old repair contract.
present_day.worst: Without a real closure and lawful transfer, preserve the actual band, school inventory and contracts. A uniform order does not decide whether children make music.
present_day.twist: The town gains only the actual reused costumes, while {B} loses the settled recurring repair contract and the school’s actual band has already ended.

npc_lines_after.line: I still recognize the stitching. The sleeves belong to different stories now.

renew_uniform_repairs requires the same band still genuinely operates, lawful owner authority, B actual qualified operating shop, surviving inventory, supported repair need and affordable actual contract. items.why_fun: The player can return to find the work of one busy room living on after that room has gone quiet.

items.title: The Partners Who Kept the Parlor after Separating
items.pitch: Introduce two adults who welcome each other. A shared unmarried household may later buy a real ice cream parlor, then end while its former partners freely keep the business together.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A local social notice records two eligible adults who never met, beside a later unfulfilled business plan.

clues.line: Both adults in {year} were single, unrelated and willing to be introduced; no relationship was promised.

window.notes: A and B are strangers relative to each other, without existing partners, with actual potential mutual attraction. C owns the identified parlor. A and B have genuinely relevant prospective operating skills. Baseline has no joint household or ownership. No marriage, child or sale is inferred from meeting.

interventions.how_it_looks: Make the welcome introduction without promising a relationship or business.

ripples.headline: Two Adults Freely Establish a Shared Unmarried Household
ripples.body: After an actual mutually developed relationship, the adults complete their lawful affordable housing arrangement without marrying.

ripples.headline: Two Qualified Partners Buy an Existing Ice Cream Parlor
ripples.body: The actual funded voluntary sale transfers only the agreed business assets and title. The owners record their precise shares and duties.

ripples.headline: Former Partners Keep a Business under an Actual New Agreement
ripples.body: The adults freely end their shared romantic household and complete viable separate housing and a lawful continuing business agreement.

fails.headline: An Introduction Does Not Establish a Household
fails.body: The meeting happens, but no qualifying shared household develops. No marriage, property or later separation is created.

present_day.best: If the chain and ownership persist in {now}, the actual parlor records both former partners’ shares while their real household records show separate residences.
present_day.worst: Without valid later agreements, retain actual relationships, homes and title. Separation never automatically sells a business or creates another home.
present_day.twist: {A} and {B} gain their actual business and keep its lawful shared ownership, but lose the real shared romantic household that began the chain.

npc_lines_after.line: We stopped sharing a home. We still have to agree about opening hours.

buy_parlor_together requires the household still intact, C actual willing transferable ownership, both buyers current qualifications and permits, clear claims, a supported price and actual affordable funding. items.why_fun: The present can hold the same two names on a business account after those names stop sharing an address.

items.title: The Jar Opener That Outlived Its Royalty
items.pitch: Help an inventor afford the actual remaining cost of a patent application. A real licence may later pay royalties before the lawful patent term ends and a qualified maker completes a new royalty-free production run.

present_hook.what_you_notice: An inventor’s file contains a working jar-opener design, genuine priority records and an unaffordable remaining application invoice.

clues.line: The device in {year} actually worked; a patent and a paying licensee were still separate decisions.

window.notes: A genuinely owns the supported eligible invention and B the actual qualified adult-owned workshop. The small gift covers the real application shortfall. Baseline has no granted patent or licence. Require actual novelty, clear rights and era-valid patent process; a useful object alone does not create exclusive rights.

interventions.how_it_looks: Give the inventor a week’s wages toward the actual remaining application costs.

ripples.headline: An Eligible Invention Receives Its Actual Patent Grant
ripples.body: The competent process grants only the supported claimed rights with their actual lawful term and conditions.

ripples.headline: A Qualified Workshop Signs a Real Manufacturing Licence
ripples.body: The parties execute the actual viable licence and complete its supported first production and royalty settlement.

ripples.headline: A Workshop Completes a Run after Actual Patent Expiry
ripples.body: The genuinely expired patent no longer requires its old licence for the covered design. The maker completes the funded lawful new run without that patent royalty.

fails.headline: The Application Produces No Qualifying Patent
fails.body: The gift remains real, but no qualifying patent is granted. No exclusive right or royalty appears from paperwork alone.

present_day.best: If the chain and legal status persist in {now}, the actual workshop’s production records show the later covered run without the expired patent royalty; the archive preserves the genuine former licence.
present_day.worst: Without a valid grant, licence and actual expiry, create no monopoly, royalty or public-use right. Other valid rights remain enforceable.
present_day.twist: {A} gains the actual earlier licence payments and then loses the expired patent’s ability to require that royalty on the later covered run.

npc_lines_after.line: It still opens the same jars. The part that stopped working was my royalty clause.
